description: This Java abstract class provides caching functionalities for widget-related data in the OFBiz framework. It manages cache names, and clearing, and provides methods to retrieve or create cache instances.

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: Abstract class providing cache management utilities for widgets within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: AbstractCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a specific ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the cache entry associated with a specific widget name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all caches that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for cache naming.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Generates the full cache name for a specific widget.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache instance for a widget, if it exists.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cache or creates a new one for a widget.
